prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1144; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped during a lane change. The patient sustained a closed fracture of the distal radius of the left wrist, with the fracture pattern consistent with a fall onto an outstretched hand at the time of impact. Initial evaluation included radiographs confirming the fracture, followed by immobilization in a splint and referral for orthopedic management.

Over the course of care, the patient completed 26 outpatient visits. Early visits focused on pain control, swelling reduction, and monitoring of neurovascular status. Once alignment was confirmed stable on follow-up imaging, the patient transitioned to a removable brace and began supervised range-of-motion exercises. Later visits concentrated on grip strength, wrist mobility, and functional return to daily activities, with home exercise instruction reinforced at each session.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full range of motion, improved grip strength, and resolution of most pain with activity. Mild residual stiffness with prolonged gripping was noted. Continued home exercise and activity modification were recommended, with follow-up as needed.
